name: Trellis
title: runtrellis.com
shortDescription: Trellis is designed to enhance revenue and streamline clinical operations for healthcare providers by automating tasks such as prior authorizations and data collection. It targets healthcare providers and diagnostic labs, automating the tedious process of form completions and data discrepancies management. An example use case is the automation of prior authorization forms, ensuring high approval rates and reducing administrative burdens.
cons: Potential privacy concerns with data handling
May require significant setup and training
